messages.subject: Help with the GGIR
parts:
Hello, I'm Carla, PhD student at the Federal University of Santa Catarina (Brazil). I've been working with accelerometry data, and I'd really like to learn how to use GGIR to analyze the data I have. For me the available manuals are not so clear. Could anyone here help a beginner researcher with the GGIR? Thank you so much for your support.

Carla

messages.author: 017566be30afa7f3
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Help with the GGIR
parts:
Hi Carla,

We offer GGIR training: https://www.accelting.com/ggir-training/ For example, the standard course that takes place in November may be of interest.

If the English language is the barrier, then another route for you is to contact fellow Brazilians that have used GGIR to help get you started, e.g. Gregory Mielke.

If these are insufficient, do not hesitate to ask questions in this google group. You may not always get a quick response as this group is run on a voluntary basis. So, the more specific your questions the easier it is for others to provide a quick reply.

Kind regards,

Vincent

Dr. Vincent van Hees | Independent consultant | https://accelting.com/
